retrievalProfile.description: A moody, low-key silhouette portrait defined by deep blue atmospheric lighting and a hazy, soft-focus texture.
excludeWhen: high-contrast black and white is requested
sharp, clear facial features are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, soft-edged silhouette of a figure standing in a dense, hazy blue environment. The lighting is primarily from behind, creating a subtle rim light on the shoulders and head, while the foreground remains in deep shadow. The overall texture is grainy and diffused, suggesting a smoke-filled or misty basement atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: Dark central silhouette against a slightly lighter blue hazy background
Top-aligned typography contrasting with the organic form below
Soft rim lighting defining the upper contours of the subject
Monochromatic blue palette with subtle magenta/red highlights in the hair
coreInvariants: Text positioned in the upper left quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central figure occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame, positioned slightly right of center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright spot of light directly above the subject's head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright light at the top, moves down the silhouette, then sweeps left to the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample hazy blue space surrounding the figure, particularly on the left side to accommodate text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and cobalt blue for shadows and midtones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale cyan and white for the light source and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle magenta and warm red glints in the rim lighting of the hair.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the shadows with high value contrast at the light source; overall low-key value range.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to blues and subtle warm rim-light accents

letterConstructionRules: Primary name in all-caps serif with high contrast
Secondary title in a fluid, slanted, hand-drawn script
Script features long, expressive ascenders and descenders
White color for maximum legibility against dark blue
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'B' and 'L' in the script are interconnected with sweeping loops
The 't' crossbars are elongated and integrated into the word flow
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Formal, high-contrast serif paired with an informal, energetic script for a sophisticated yet personal feel.

preserve: All-caps serif for the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant serif feel of the primary name.
Captures the casual, energetic movement of the secondary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a hazy, monochromatic blue photograph of a person's silhouette from the waist up. Use a strong overhead/backlight to create a soft glow and rim light on the head and shoulders. The atmosphere should be thick with mist or smoke, creating a grainy, diffused texture throughout.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a white, all-caps high-contrast serif font at the top left. Below it, add the title in a white, hand-drawn style script, slanted upwards at a 15-degree angle, ensuring the script looks fluid and organic.

verificationChecks: Is the overall color palette dominated by blue?
Is the subject a soft-edged silhouette?
Is the script text slanted upwards?
Is there a visible grain or haze texture?

adjustableVariables: Amount of rim lighting on the silhouette
mustRedesign: Do not replicate the exact original wording
Ensure the script is custom-drawn rather than a standard digital font

mustAchieve: Legible white typography against a dark background
A sense of depth within the haze
avoid: Flat, solid black silhouettes without rim light

postGenerationChecks: Verify the 'glow' effect at the top center
Ensure the script text has a hand-drawn, energetic quality
Confirm the silhouette is the primary focal point
recipe.reuseFormula: Silhouette + Hazy Blue Lighting + High-Contrast Serif + Slanted Script = 70s Soul Aesthetic
